query:
UPDATE algo_exes
            SET review_status = $2,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = (
                SELECT algo_exes.id FROM algo_exes
                JOIN algos ON algo_exes.algo_id = algos.id
                WHERE algos.cid = $1
                ORDER BY algo_exes.created_at DESC
                LIMIT 1
            )
